Firebase JS SDK 10.7.1 (compat builds), copied unchanged from https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.7.1/ on 2026-11-14.
Served from the app's own site so a slow or filtered www.gstatic.com can no longer hold the app at its first screen.
Licence: Apache License 2.0 - https://github.com/firebase/firebase-js-sdk/blob/main/LICENSE
Upgrading: put the new version in a new folder (vendor/firebase-<version>/) and update the two <script> tags and VENDOR_PRECACHE in farin-sw.js.
